Team GET needs team.read; team POST (invite by e-mail, role, suspend, reactivate) also needs team.roles.assign, a membership revision and the store's last-administrator lock. Invite links an existing partner account or creates an invited one with a single-use token and sends mail to /partner/set-password; at most 5 invitations per actor and hour; the response never reveals whether the address existed. set-password consumes the token, sets the scrypt hash, bumps the auth epoch and activates invited memberships; Studio login still refuses role partner.

sourceRouteCatalog.pathConvention: path is the Next pattern inside the app. Public product paths are /control, /partner and /play. :id is one segment, :path+ a required catch-all, :path* an optional catch-all. /studio is the lab basePath, not a product.
sourceRouteCatalog.methodConvention: methods lists only HTTP verbs explicitly exported by route.ts. Next page components have methods=[]; implicit framework HEAD/OPTIONS and unsupported verbs are not inferred.
sourceRouteCatalog.servingConvention: Services describe platform routing with native Studio enabled in existing code, with conditional legacy/local branches stated. Source file existence does not prove a handler is reached on a deployed public origin.
caveats: No deployed route, live authorization, native browser UI or provider was exercised for this catalog.
Historical alias route files are marked historicalAlias and remain distinct from their redirect target; no extra QA-query rows duplicate a file.

Manually registered web server routes, native Node WebSocket endpoints outside app and framework-generated assets are covered by existing groups only; this bounded file catalog is not an exhaustive server-regex inventory.
